summary: US Central Command chief visited Israel for situational assessments amid ongoing Gaza operations and potential ceasefire discussions. Iran's Ground Force remains on full combat alert, prepared to respond to threats. IDF continues operations in Lebanon, destroying Hezbollah infrastructure and recovering a fallen Israeli soldier in the Jordan River.
key_points: US Central Command chief Brad Cooper visited Israel for situational assessments with IDF officials following meetings in Bahrain and UAE (Source: @Faytuks_Network/6171).
Iran's Army Ground Force is on full alert, ready to respond decisively to any threat against the country (Source: @presstv/202139).
IDF's Unit 55 and Golani Brigade discovered and destroyed Hezbollah underground ammunition storage facilities in southern Lebanon (Source: @yediotnews25/133736).
Yemeni Armed Forces conducted missile and drone strikes killing Saudi-backed mercenaries in southwestern Yemen (Source: @presstv/202133).
Egyptian Foreign Minister Shafik al-Sadr emphasized the need for full Israeli withdrawal from Gaza in a phone call with UN Special Coordinator for Gaza (Source: @SharghDaily/177108).
An American MQ-9 drone crashed at Chabelley Air Base in Djibouti, prompting a distress warning (Source: @naya_foriraq/87386).
Hamas urged mediators and America to pressure Netanyahu to adhere to the Gaza peace roadmap (Source: @presstv/202136).

sections.threat_assessment: The situation remains volatile with ongoing military operations across multiple theaters. Iran's Ground Force is on high alert, potentially escalating tensions if cross-border incidents occur. Hezbollah's infrastructure in Lebanon faces sustained IDF operations, risking broader regional escalation. Yemen's conflict continues with Houthi missile strikes on Saudi-backed positions. The MQ-9 drone crash in Djibouti highlights the risk of broader regional military engagement.
sections.regional_response: Egypt is actively mediating a potential Gaza ceasefire, emphasizing full Israeli withdrawal. The US is pressuring Israel to transition to the next phase of the Gaza plan. Switzerland is emerging as a candidate for foreign monitoring of the Israel-Lebanon agreement. Saudi Arabia's Aramco facility fire underscores energy infrastructure vulnerabilities. Regional actors are balancing between escalation and de-escalation efforts.
sections.intelligence_notes: Iran's Ground Force readiness signals potential for rapid response to perceived threats. The MQ-9 drone crash in Djibouti may indicate operational challenges or security incidents in the region. Hezbollah's infrastructure destruction in Lebanon suggests IDF's broader campaign against the group. Yemen's missile strikes on Saudi-backed positions indicate ongoing Houthi capabilities. The Swiss monitoring proposal reflects diplomatic efforts to manage regional tensions.
